column1: # Concept: linear aggro. Aura Jab (130) refuels itself from the discard pile and
# Mega Brave (270) one-shots most of the format. Two attacks
# no combo. Serves as the aggressive pole of the Week-4 H4 experiment.
# a bounded local search against a real Crustle (id 345) ex-counter wall found
# this deck's worst-case matchup was 2% (Crustle blocks all damage from ex/
# Mega-ex attackers -- this deck's entire win condition). 4 accepted single-card
# swaps raise that to 14% without weakening any other matchup (94-98% held).
